searchText: If there's anyone here with an adequate understanding of the underlying math to give a review of https://github.com/ethereum/eth-keys/pull/76 it would be appreciated. I added a comment on the PR, I have not used python in any meaningful capacity, so I did not comment on about half of the PR It might make sense to split this PR into two: - First one to push just the bug fix in a naive way (without breaking any assumptions the library is making for example) - Second to make improvements on the code I'm a huge fan of this strategy in general for PRs. Code cleanup/refactoring in separate PRs from bug fixes in separate PRs from feature additions is great for reviewability.
